    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ActionError
    Enumerates the error categories that may be returned to a client when a requested player action is rejected by the model.
    ActionResult
    Immutable response returned by the GameModel for every player action.
    ActionType
    Identifies the kind of player action that produced an ActionResult.
    ArtistCard
    Concrete CharacterCard representing the Artist archetype.
    Board
    Central game board.
    BoardState
    Immutable snapshot of the central board, suitable for sending across the network.
    BuilderCard
    Concrete CharacterCard representing the Builder archetype.
    BuildingCard
    Concrete card representing a building.
    BuildingCardState
    Immutable snapshot of a building card.
    BuildingDeck
    Per-era deck of BuildingCard.
    BuildingEffect
    Persistent effect attached to a building card.
    BuildingEffectName
    Canonical identifier of each building effect implementation.
    BuildingsDeserializer
     
    Card
    Abstract base class for every card playable in the game.
    CardDrawState
    Per-turn draw state used by Game to track how many cards a player has already drawn from each row during the resolution of an offer tile.
    CardImageResolver
     
    CardKind
    High level classification of the cards used by the model.
    CardMarket
    The card market exposed to players during the drawing phase.
    CardNodeFactory
     
    CardNotDrawableException
    Thrown when a player attempts to draw a card that, due to game rules or the current board state, cannot be drawn from the card market.
    CardsTakenPayload
    Notification sent after a draw action, describing which cards the player took, their economic impact and the state of the game right after the action.
    CardState
    Common base class for the serializable, immutable snapshots of any card exposed by the model to its clients.
    CavePaintingsEffectData
    Mutable accumulator collecting the bonuses contributed by building effects during the resolution of a Cave Paintings event.
    CavePaintingsEventCard
    Event card implementing the Cave Paintings scoring rule.
    CavePaintingsFoodPerArtistEffect
    Building effect granting bonus food during the resolution of the Cave Paintings event, proportional to the number of Artist cards owned.
    CharacterCard
    Abstract base class for the cards representing tribe characters.
    CharacterCardState
    Immutable snapshot of a character card.
    CharactersDeserializer
     
    CharacterType
    Enumerates the character archetypes available in the game.
    CLIColors
     
    ClientLauncher
     
    CLITribeRenderer
     
    CLIView
    Command line view for the Mesos client.
    ConnectionController
     
    ConnectMessage
     
    Connector
    Per-client connection handler on the server side.
    CreateLobbyMessage
     
    DatabaseConfig
    Read-only configuration for the JDBC connection used by the leaderboard repository.
    DisconnectMessage
     
    DoubleBuilderEndGameEffect
    End-of-game building effect that grants extra prestige points equal to the sum of the printed points of every character card owned by the player.
    DoubleShamanWinEffect
    Shaman ritual building effect that doubles the prestige points awarded to the player when they win the ritual.
    EndGamePointsPerCharacterTypeEffect
    End-of-game building effect that grants a configurable amount of prestige points per character of a target type owned by the player.
    EndGamePointsPerCompleteSetEffect
    End-of-game building effect that awards prestige points per complete character set in the player's tribe.
    EndOfPlacingPhasePayload
    Notification dispatched when all players completed the placing phase.
    Era
    Identifies the current era of the game.
    EraProgressionPayload
    Notification sent when the game progresses to a new era and the building row is refreshed accordingly.
    EraProgressionResult
    Outcome of an era progression performed by CardMarket.handleEraProgression(BuildingDeck, Era).
    ErrorCode
    Machine readable error codes carried by ActionResult when an action is rejected by the GameModel.
    EventCard
    Abstract base class for the event cards.
    EventCardState
    Immutable snapshot of an event card.
    EventResolvedPayload
    Notification carrying the outcome of a single event card resolution.
    EventResolver
    Resolves event cards against a Game instance.
    EventsDeserializer
     
    ExtraCardTakenPayload
    Notification sent when a player consumed an extra draw opportunity granted by a building effect.
    ExtraDrawEffect
    Building effect that schedules an extra draw turn for the owning player once the building is purchased.
    ExtraDrawRequestPayload
    Notification sent to ask the entitled player to perform their extra draw.
    FlatEndGamePointsEffect
    End-of-game building effect that awards a fixed amount of prestige points regardless of the player's tribe composition.
    FoodFromTurnOrderBonusEffect
    Building effect that adds a flat food bonus on top of the food granted by the turn order slot the owning player landed on.
    FoodPerCompletedSetEffect
    Building effect that grants 5 food every time the player completes a new character set after acquiring this building.
    FoodPerInventorPairEffect
    Building effect that grants 3 food every time the player completes a new inventor pair after acquiring this building.
    Game
    Reference implementation of GameModel.
    GameController
    MVC controller that bridges the network layer and the model.
    GameModel
    Interface exposed by the model to the controller layer.
    GamePhase
    Lifecycle phases of a match, traversed sequentially by the model.
    GameScreenController
     
    GameStartedPayload
    Notification dispatched right after the game starts, carrying the initial snapshot of the model so clients can render the starting state.
    GameState
    Immutable serializable snapshot of the whole game.
    GathererCard
    Concrete CharacterCard representing the Gatherer archetype.
    HeartbeatService
    Schedules a periodic ping toward the supplied RMI server to detect connection drops.
    HunterCard
    Concrete CharacterCard representing the Hunter archetype.
    HuntingEffectData
    Mutable accumulator collecting the bonuses contributed by building effects during the resolution of a Hunting event.
    HuntingEventCard
    Event card implementing the Hunting scoring rule.
    HuntingRewardPerHunterEffect
    Building effect applied during the Hunting event: contributes one extra food and one extra prestige point per Hunter owned by the player.
    IconImageResolver
     
    IconNodeFactory
     
    IllegalActionException
    Thrown when a player attempts to perform an action that is not allowed in the current game phase or with the current state of the model.
    InventionIcon
    Enumerates the icons that appear on Inventor cards, used to compute pair matches for inventor related effects.
    InventorCard
    Concrete CharacterCard representing the Inventor archetype.
    JavaFXView
     
    JoinLobbyMessage
     
    LeaderboardController
     
    LeaderboardPayload
    Notification carrying the global leaderboard for matches with a given number of players.
    LeaderboardRepository
    JDBC-backed repository that persists the per-match scores and serves the leaderboard queries.
    LeaveLobbyMessage
     
    LobbyController
     
    LobbyPhase
    Lifecycle status of a lobby.
    LobbyState
    Serializable snapshot of a lobby.
    MarketRefresherPayload
    Notification sent during the end-of-round cleanup describing how the card market and the surrounding board areas have been refreshed.
    MatchRankingsPayload
    Sent at game end after the local scoreboard.
    Message
    Marker base class for every typed message exchanged over the socket transport.
    ModelObserver
    Observer interface implemented by the controller (and ultimately the network layer) to receive notifications about the model lifecycle.
    NetworkSetter
    Helper used by the client side to establish a connection over the desired transport (RMI or socket).
    NoFreeSlotsException
    Thrown when an operation requires a free slot on a board structure (e.g. the turn order tile) but none is available.
    NoLossIfLastShamanEffect
    Shaman ritual building effect that prevents the prestige loss when the player ends up last in the ritual ranking.
    NotificationType
    Identifies the type of notification dispatched by the model to its observers.
    OfferAction
    Immutable description of the draws and the food reward granted by an OfferTile.
    OfferTile
    One of the offer tiles on the central board.
    OfferTileNodeFactory
     
    OfferTileNotFoundException
    Thrown when a lookup for an offer tile fails because no tile matches the provided identifier on the current board.
    OfferTilesDeserializer
     
    OfferTileState
    Immutable snapshot of an offer tile.

    Player
    Represents a player participating in the match.
    PlayerConnectionInfo
    Minimal serializable descriptor of a connected player, used during the lobby and setup phases before the full Player model is instantiated.
    PlayerDelta
    Per-player resource delta produced by a game event, paired with the absolute values reached after the event has been applied.
    PlayerNotFoundException
    Thrown when a player lookup fails because the supplied identifier does not match any player currently registered in the match.
    PlayerScore
    Final score breakdown for a single player.
    PlayerState
    Immutable snapshot of a player, including their resources, totem color and the cards they currently own.
    RankingEntry
    Immutable entry of the global leaderboard, ready to be serialized and shipped to clients.
    RefillResult
    Outcome of a top row refill performed by CardMarket.refillTopRow(TribeDeck, int, Era).
    RefreshLobbyListMessage
     
    RequestLeaderboardMessage
     
    ResourceLoader
     
    RmiClient
    RMI implementation of the VirtualViewRmi remote view.
    RmiServer
    RMI adapter exposing the controller as a VirtualServerRmi.
    RmiServerLauncher
    Standalone entry point that boots only the RMI transport.
    RowType
    Identifies one of the two rows of the CardMarket.
    ScoreboardController
     
    ScoreBoardPayload
    Notification carrying the final scoreboard at the end of the match.
    ScoreCalculator
    Computes the end-of-game scores for every player in the Game.
    ScoreEntry
    Serializable per player score entry.
    ScoreResult
    Mutable in-memory per-player score record produced by the ScoreCalculator.
    SelectedCardExtraDraw
    DTO that identifies the card a player wants to take during their extra draw turn.
    SelectedSingleCard
    DTO that identifies the card a player wants to take during a normal draw action.
    ServerLauncher
    Entry point of the server application.
    Setup
    Builder that turns the raw, JSON-loaded game material into a fully configured Game ready to start a match.
    ShamanBonusStarsEffect
    Shaman ritual building effect that contributes a configurable amount of bonus stars to the owning player's total during the ritual ranking.
    ShamanCard
    Concrete CharacterCard representing the Shaman archetype.
    ShamanRitualEffectData
    Mutable accumulator collecting the bonuses contributed by building effects during the resolution of a Shaman Ritual event.
    ShamanRitualEventCard
    Event card implementing the Shaman Ritual scoring rule.
    SkipTurnMessage
     
    SocketClient
    Client-side socket transport.
    SocketServer
    Server-side socket acceptor.
    SocketServerLauncher
    Standalone entry point that boots only the socket transport.
    StartGameMessage
     
    SustenanceDiscountPerTypeEffect
    Sustenance building effect that reduces the cost paid during the Sustenance event by a configurable amount per character of the supplied type owned by the player.
    SustenanceEventCard
    Event card implementing the Sustenance rule.
    TakeCardMessage
     
    TakeExtraCardMessage
     
    TileImageResolver
     
    TileNotEmptyException
    Thrown when a placement operation is attempted on a tile that is already occupied by another totem or piece.
    Totem
    The pawn placed by a player on the offer track and on the turn order tile to claim an action.
    TotemAreaType
    Identifies the kind of board area on which a totem can be located.
    TotemColors
    Color identity of a player's totem.
    TotemPlacedPayload
    Notification sent when a player places their totem on an offer tile.
    TotemPositionState
    Placeholder class kept for potential future use as a serializable totem position descriptor.
    Tribe
    The collection of cards owned by a single player.
    TribeDeck
    Single deck used to refill the card market top row.
    TurnOrderDeserializer
     
    TurnOrderNodeFactory
     
    TurnOrderSlot
    One of the slots of the turn order tile.
    TurnOrderSlotNotFoundException
    Thrown when a lookup on the turn order tile fails because no slot matches the supplied criteria.
    TurnOrderSlotState
    Immutable snapshot of a single turn order slot, including the resource delta granted by the slot and the player currently occupying it.
    TurnOrderTile
    The turn order tile: an ordered list of TurnOrderSlot on which players are placed to determine the round's turn order.
    UnmatchedGameCriteriaException
    Thrown when the requested game configuration does not match any of the supported game criteria (e.g. unsupported player count).
